title: Listening Drill — Indoor plant exchange — Guided practice
description: Practical demonstration. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Indoor plant exchange — Guided practice
sections.transcript:
TUTOR: Before our demonstration on indoor plant exchange, let me explain what you need and what to record. Collect your materials from the covered stall before the demonstration begins. Inside the handout you will find a blank seed list to fill in.

TUTOR: Watch the demonstration once before you try it. Before you begin, check for the fault that affected the previous group: wet label. If you notice it, let me know instead of making an adjustment yourself.

TUTOR: Now work in pairs. After the first attempt, check variety name and write the result down immediately. You then have fifteen minutes to compare your result with your partner’s. You can disagree, but both partners should keep a note of what they observed.

TUTOR: On your way out, take anything you borrowed back to the market arch. Please leave your notes in the folder so we can discuss them next time.
